Rebuild of v0.9.0 so every file is byte-identical to a local `./build.sh` again. No module code changed.

- `decision-table.wasm`, `json-schema-validator.wasm` and `spreadsheet-calc.wasm` in v0.9.0 work as described but could not be reproduced locally: Cargo includes the absolute path of the patched crates in `vendor/` in its build, and GitHub builds from a different folder than `./build.sh`. The release workflow now builds from the same path, so these three files match a local build byte for byte.

The other modules are unchanged and were already reproducible. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
